top_stories.title: Hackers breach Microsoft 365 tenants via ConnectWise supply-chain attack
top_stories.summary: ConnectWise shut down customer access to its Cloud Backup service after hackers compromised application identities and breached Microsoft 365 tenants in a supply-chain attack. The attack vector involved unauthorized access to application identities, resulting in downstream compromise of Microsoft 365 environments across affected tenants.

top_stories.title: China-Linked Hackers Exploited BeyondTrust Zero-Day to Take Over Remote Support Servers
top_stories.summary: A China-linked cyber espionage group tracked as Armory Castle exploited a critical zero-day vulnerability (CVE-2026-102764, CVSS 9.3) in BeyondTrust Remote Support to take over remote support servers in late August 2026. The flaw involves improper origin validation in an internal messaging component of BeyondTrust's Remote Support product, formerly known as Bomgar.

top_stories.title: BeyondTrust patches zero-day exploited in attacks since August
top_stories.summary: BeyondTrust disclosed a critical zero-day vulnerability in its Remote Support product that has been actively exploited in attacks since late August. The flaw prompted an emergency patch warning to customers, highlighting a security risk in a widely-used privileged access management vendor's tooling.

top_stories.title: Hackers Use Compromised ConnectWise Credential to Sign In to 173 Microsoft 365 Tenants
top_stories.summary: Threat actors used a compromised ConnectWise Cloud Backup credential to gain unauthorized access to 173 Microsoft 365 tenants belonging to MSP customers. The attack highlights the risk of credential compromise in third-party service provider accounts that have delegated access to multiple customer Microsoft 365 environments.

top_stories.title: Nine Identity-Layer Bypasses in Twenty-One Days: The Trust-Through-Defaults Pattern Has Reached Every Layer of the Stack
top_stories.summary: Nine distinct identity-layer bypasses were disclosed across the authentication stack within a 21-day window between late September and mid-October 2026. Each vulnerability exploited a common structural pattern where receiving systems implicitly trusted assertions from upstream sources without sufficient validation, affecting multiple tiers of the identity stack.

news.title: ConnectWise Suspends Cloud Backup After Attackers Compromise Microsoft 365 Tenants
news.summary: ConnectWise disabled seven application identities after threat actors gained unauthorized access to them and used them to compromise Microsoft 365 tenants. The incident led ConnectWise to suspend its Cloud Backup service while the investigation continues.

news.title: The Industry’s Primary Agent Identity Standard Expires in 36 Days
news.summary: The ID-JAG (Identity for JSON Agentic) draft standard, described as the industry's primary agent identity standard, is set to expire on November 22, 2026, with 36 days remaining. The expiration highlights a gap between commercially deployed agentic AI infrastructure and the pace of institutional standards development for agent identity.

news.title: Mage OSS Ships an OAuth Bypass That Creates Sessions from Unrecognized Providers — the Tenth Trust-Through-Defaults Incident in Twenty-One Days
news.summary: Mage OSS has a critical authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-111823, CVSS 9.8) that allows session creation from unrecognized OAuth providers, affecting all versions through 0.9.80. The flaw is categorized as a trust-through-defaults issue in OAuth implementation, enabling unauthorized access without valid credentials.

news.title: Microsoft Is Blocking Every Third-Party Script from Its Entra Sign-In Page — and It Hits Mid-October
news.summary: Microsoft will enforce Content Security Policy (CSP) on Entra sign-in pages at login.microsoftonline.com starting mid-to-late October 2026, blocking all third-party scripts not originating from trusted Microsoft domains. The change is part of Microsoft's Secure Future Initiative and will impact organizations that have injected custom or third-party scripts into Entra sign-in pages.

news.title: Six Vendors Are Shipping Agent Identity Products. The IETF Has Not Finished the Standard.
news.summary: Six vendors are shipping agent identity products despite the IETF's ID-JAG standard remaining an unfinished Internet-Draft (version -04, expiring November 22). The article examines the standardization gap where commercial implementations are outpacing the formal specification process for agent identity.

news.title: The IETF Is Formalizing the Identity Layer Vendors Are Already Shipping
news.summary: The IETF is working to formalize identity standards for autonomous agents as organizations prepare to manage large numbers of non-human identities. The standardization effort addresses authentication and authorization infrastructure for AI agents, an area where vendors have already begun shipping their own implementations.

news.title: BeyondTrust Remote Support Zero-Day Continues Trend of Exploited Edge Bugs
news.summary: A zero-day vulnerability in BeyondTrust Remote Support has been actively exploited, joining a wave of edge device vulnerabilities affecting Ivanti, Cisco, and Palo Alto Networks. BeyondTrust is a privileged access management (PAM) vendor, and the flaw targets its remote support product used for managing privileged sessions.

news.title: Why Active Directory weaknesses stay open for years in teams with one or two admins
news.summary: An interview with intcube CTO David Fuhr covers a 12-week security cohort where 27 municipalities collaborated to harden Windows Server and Active Directory configurations. The program addressed specific AD security settings including SMB signing, LDAP signing, and Kerberos hardening, with lab testing used to validate changes before deployment.

news.title: UAT-11985 Uses Fake Event Invites to Target Taiwan Research Affiliates With Google AitM Phishing
news.summary: Researchers have disclosed details of an APT spear-phishing campaign (UAT-11985) targeting Taiwan research organization affiliates using fake event invites to direct victims to an adversary-in-the-middle phishing framework. The campaign is designed to harvest Google account credentials and MFA codes, bypassing multi-factor authentication protections.

news.title: Keeper Security and Tenable Integrate to Streamline Cloud Risk Detection, Remediation and Vulnerability Assessment
news.summary: Keeper Security and Tenable have announced an integration between Keeper's identity security platform and Tenable's cloud risk and vulnerability assessment tools. The integration enables remediation of cloud security findings and secures privileged credentials used during vulnerability scanning.

news.title: CMA takes first steps to ensure choice in business software
news.summary: The UK Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) has proposed designating Microsoft with strategic market status in its business software ecosystem. This regulatory action could have implications for Microsoft's identity and access management products, including Entra ID, given their deep integration within the broader Microsoft 365 and Azure business software ecosystem.

news.title: jumpserver v5.1.0
news.summary: JumpServer has released version 5.1.0 of its open-source Privileged Access Management platform. The platform provides DevOps and IT teams with secure access to SSH, RDP, Kubernetes, database, and RemoteApp endpoints through a web browser.

news.title: GhostAction Compromises About 1,900 GitHub Accounts, Targets Over 30,000 Repositories
news.summary: A credential-theft campaign called GhostAction compromised approximately 1,900 GitHub accounts and targeted over 30,000 repositories across 3,000 users and organizations. The attack, observed on October 8-9, 2026 and reported by GitGuardian, attempted to extract 3,174 secrets from public repositories' CI pipelines.

news.title: Canonical releases Ubuntu 26.10 Stonking Stingray
news.summary: Canonical released Ubuntu 26.10 Stonking Stingray, an interim release that includes improvements to enterprise identity integration among other features. The release also introduces post-quantum package signing, Rust coreutils, and privacy-focused speech-to-text capabilities.

news.title: Ivanti ICS Zero-Day Attacks Highlight Vendor Patching Hurdles
news.summary: A high-severity zero-day vulnerability (CVE-2026-104935) affecting Ivanti ICS combines authentication bypass and remote code execution, and was only partially discovered and patched in July. The incomplete patch left a window for threat actors to exploit the authentication bypass flaw in active attacks.

news.title: Anthropic 'SneakPeek' Flaw Is a Silent Zero-Click Threat
news.summary: A vulnerability dubbed "SneakPeek" in Anthropic's Claude Code Desktop application allows attackers to silently steal credentials via the preview pane without any user interaction. The flaw can expose SSH private keys, AWS credentials, and OAuth tokens belonging to developers.

news.title: Employees Built the Agents. Enterprises Just Bought the Supervisors.
news.summary: The article examines a growing divide in enterprise AI agent deployment, distinguishing between IT-sanctioned agents managed through identity governance platforms like Okta and employee-built or unsanctioned agents operating outside formal controls. The piece addresses how this split creates challenges for identity governance and access monitoring of non-human identities in the enterprise.

news.title: Zero-Days Lurk in Microsoft's Overgrown October Patch Tuesday
news.summary: Microsoft's October Patch Tuesday, described as the largest security update ever, contains multiple zero-day vulnerabilities including defense bypasses and unauthenticated remote code execution flaws. The update is notable for its scale and the presence of security control bypass vulnerabilities, which have direct implications for authentication and access control mechanisms.

news.title: No Identity, No Recovery: Cyber Resilience Starts With IAM
news.summary: The article addresses the critical role of identity and access management in cyber resilience strategies, arguing that IAM must be central to recovery planning. It focuses on the challenges posed by enterprise app proliferation and reliance on cloud identity providers.

news.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 1,000 Security Holes
news.summary: Microsoft released a record-breaking patch update addressing at least 974 security vulnerabilities across Windows and other software. AI is being credited with accelerating vulnerability discovery, though security teams are struggling to prioritize and deploy the volume of fixes.

news.title: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
news.summary: A dark web service is selling digital scans of over 153 million drivers licenses from the US and Canada, apparently sourced from a Louisiana-based identity verification company. The FBI's New Orleans field office has opened an official investigation into the breach of the identity verification provider.
